create_EllipticEnvelope: create an EllipticEnvelope outlier detection model for Gaussian distributed datasets
fit_EllipticEnvelope: fit the EllipticEnvelope model on training data to estimate robust location and covariance
predict_EllipticEnvelope: predict inlier and outlier labels using the fitted EllipticEnvelope decision function
score_samples_EllipticEnvelope: compute negative Mahalanobis distances of samples against the fitted EllipticEnvelope model
decision_function_EllipticEnvelope: compute the decision function scores for outlier detection with the EllipticEnvelope model
